title: Escalation Routing Rule R-008: Discharge blocked by billing
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-008 -- Discharge blocked by billing
TRIGGER TYPE: Data State
CONDITION: Discharge signed but billing clearance is FALSE
ROUTE TO: Billing (Extension 1028)
QUEUE: QUEUE_BILLING
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 2.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Causes inpatient bed blockage. Discharge gate pass cannot be issued until billing is cleared. Contact Billing ext. 1028.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Discharge for Bed 07 blocked because bill is not generated
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Nursing cleared but stuck waiting for bill
